fusions.name: Flying Wedge
fusions.desc: Runs the pack through in a wedge, which deals 4 damage to everything in a cone 3.5 tiles long. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Dunked
fusions.desc: Lunges at an enemy up to 5 tiles away and ducks it under, which deals 12 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wet-Coat Shake
fusions.desc: Sheds up to 3 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Dry-Shod Pursuit
fusions.desc: You walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
